gaps.evidence: The paper proposes graphical reporting of health utility alongside mortality on Kaplan-Meier curves, but the method-function vocabulary has no reporting or visualization value.

gaps.proposed_resolution: Consider a method function for reporting or visualization if this use recurs across studies.
